how_to_run: For each case, give the prompt and the fixture to two fresh agents in identical sandboxes: one with the kit installed (`init`), one without (the baseline). Build both, serve the production build, run skills/immersive-inspect/scripts/inspect.mjs on each and keep the FAIL/WARN counts. A judge who does not know which is which scores both sets of screenshots with skills/immersive-inspect/references/critique.md. Then check every grader below against the kit run's files and transcript. Record results in evals/RESULTS.md with the date, agent and model.

cases.fixture: static HTML/CSS site with a brand stylesheet, no build step
cases.prompt: Make the homepage of this ceramics studio feel premium and memorable with an interactive 3D hero. We fire stoneware at 1,280 °C in a wood kiln twice a year in Mashiko. Keep it fast on phones.
graders: inspect.mjs exits 0 on the result at 1440/768/390
.immersive/CONCEPTS.md has an inventory of 8+ items drawn from the brief (temperature, wood kiln, twice a year, Mashiko)
The idea sentence fails the competitor swap (uses something only this studio has)
The visitor has a verb with a visible consequence (not scroll-only)
three.js is loaded lazily after first paint; the poster is the LCP element
No-WebGL and reduced-motion screenshots show complete content and a designed still
No invented testimonials, logos or statistics
cases.expected: A vanilla three.js island loaded on idle, a poster fallback of identical size, a kiln/glaze interaction from the subject, and a HANDOVER.md with measurements and critique scores.

cases.fixture: Next.js 15 app router + Tailwind 4 + TypeScript, existing design tokens in globals.css
cases.prompt: Build a 3D landing hero for our invoicing product. Use our existing brand.
graders: Uses @react-three/fiber via next/dynamic with ssr:false inside a 'use client' boundary; no new styling system added
Colours in the scene come from the existing CSS tokens (uniforms read from CSS variables)
audit.mjs has zero FAIL; tsc and next build pass
inspect.mjs exits 0; draws/frame within budget on mobile
Copy deck headlines are two lines or fewer at 390px in the screenshots
cases.expected: A native R3F island with tiers, pause control and context-loss handling; no framework migration.

cases.fixture: Astro 5 site with Markdown content collections
cases.prompt: I want my portfolio to feel like an award-winning site with scroll storytelling between projects.
graders: Islands use client:visible / client:idle; no full-page hydration
Scroll is never hijacked; content readable with JavaScript disabled
Every section carries the idea (not a distinctive hero followed by stock blocks) per the critique pass 8
Reduced-motion pass: no scrubbed or parallax motion, all text visible
cases.expected: Pinned story built with the kit's motion templates and a still fallback per section.

cases.fixture: an existing three.js landing page with no reduced-motion handling, no fallback and a 4 MB uncompressed GLB
cases.prompt: Audit our 3D homepage before launch and fix what would fail an enterprise review.
graders: Runs audit.mjs and inspect.mjs before changing anything and reports their findings
Fixes: reduced motion, WebGL fallback, context loss, DPR clamp, compresses the GLB with optimize-assets
Re-runs both tools and shows the before/after numbers
Does not redesign the page or change its concept
cases.expected: A findings table ordered by severity with file:line evidence, the fixes, and re-measured numbers.

cases.prompt: Add a date-range filter to the orders table.
graders: The kit's build workflow does not start (no .immersive/ folder, no 3D dependencies added)
The change is a normal, minimal component edit
cases.expected: The agent does the small task without invoking the immersive pipeline.
